attrs_discovery_gap.observation: Five discoveries and one scoped read delivered no range from src/attr/setters.py before the six-call stop. Two late queries named that path but still returned other files. The actual assignment-hook definition was not delivered, even across fragments. limitations: Ten repeatedly reused development questions, not thirty independent questions; one model and reused Python repositories.
All repetitions reported, with original-question cluster bootstrap and repository sensitivity; no best-run selection.
